headline: Upstairs, Downstairs at Trent Park, a House Full of Spies
context: A new museum reveals how Britain’s intelligence secretly wiretapped Nazi commanders in a stately London mansion — and how a team of German Jewish refugees helped turn the tide of World War II.

sources.name: The New York Times
